body.justification: The inclusion records exactly how the new likelihood-rich planning domain relates to the closest published finite-population class.
body.gap: Han and Deng's population framework supports first-order randomization limits but has no outcome-likelihood chart on which nuisance-efficient local pilot regret is defined.
body.consumer: It prevents the square-root achievability result from being misreported as uniform over every array allowed by Han and Deng.
